paragraphs.text: Borben was a coastal town situated in a sheltered bay by a peninsula on the edge of Otaria , on the plane of Dominaria .

The town of Borben sat at the end of a major trade road, the last habitation before the open ocean. A long peninsula jutted out from the mainland, creating a protected bay. Like a single finger of hills, it beckoned to ships searching for port. Waterfowl and a few seals sunning themselves populated the last spit of land.

In 4305 AR , Kamahl came to Borben seeking the Mirari . He joined the local pit fights, where he defeated the necromancer Apel without killing him. The same night, three young men, Birten , Wasel and Girter asked to become his apprentices. Although Kamahl agreed, a huge tsunami rose due to Aboshan 's misuse of the Mirari . Although Kamahl survived, the three men were never mentioned again, and the entire area around Borben was sunk to the bottom of the ocean.
